decisionsTitle: The guide covers the October releases: the hourly limit and the Gmail road, the bulk resend, the chosen offers, the places line, the numbers column (amending §441)
decisionsSection:
**Amends §441.** The owner, 2026-10-01, on the race's first day of registrations, from his phone: «Trebuie să actualizăm și documentația live pt voluntari». Three releases had shipped or were shipping that night — the outbox's hourly pace for Mailgun (§605), the bulk resend of the declaration (§606) and the batch with the costs page (§610), the offered place on the card (§612), the numbers column (§613), the journey's step (§614), the chosen offers and the places line (§615) and the declaration box (§616) — and «Ghid» said nothing of any of them. Of the chosen offers he had said the same morning: «Basically I wanna hand pick people from the waiting list and give them a seat».

**Decision.** «Ghid» (`/admin/guide`, `Admin.guide` in both catalogues) describes exactly what this tree does, as §441's jobs — a title and short numbered steps, the screen's own words in «…», roles never people — and nothing that is not built (no Gmail takeover, no public delay notice, no page for a replaced link).

- **«Planul Mailgun, înainte și după cursă»** (Administrator) is rewritten to match the screen: the plan dropdown and the note; «Limita pe oră» — how many leave through Mailgun in an hour, the rest waiting in the queue and none lost, write 90 while Mailgun keeps the account limited — the box is pre-filled with the stored value, 100 by default, which is the hard limit with no margin, so the step uses the box's own verb (its help says «pune 90») rather than "leave" — and on QA, which shares the domain, about 10, as `SETUP.md` §35 asks; raised or cleared once the limit is lifted; «Salvează planul», after which «Costuri», «Trimise în ultima oră:» and «Trimite acum» follow it; «Prin ce pleacă emailurile: Mailgun sau Gmail-ul clubului», the road per group, with «Limita Gmail pe zi (destinatari)», the pause and «Salvează drumurile»; and after the race, Free again.
- **«Emailurile întârzie sau Mailgun a refuzat»** (new, Administrator): where to read «Trimise în ultima oră:» and «În coadă:», what a red «Întârziat…» row means, how a pause Mailgun asked for shows («Ultimul răspuns al furnizorului:» starting "paused by the provider") and that it spends no attempt, when «Trimite acum» helps (Gmail's road, an hour with room) and when it cannot, what to tell participants (Spam and Promotions), and when to write to a Superadministrator, or the club's owner, as the guide's troubleshooting line already says (a row «Oprit după toate încercările», red rows still there an hour later, a last hour stuck at 0 while the queue grows). Only verbs the Administrator has.
- **«Retrimite declarația celor care nu au semnat»** (new, Administrator): the event's «Înscrierile primite» → «Retrimite declarația tuturor care nu au semnat», the dialog's counts and who is skipped, the «La coadă:» banner, three presses an hour, the "i" that says why a press would be refused, and the two warnings — the earlier link stops working, and people should look in Spam and Promotions. The single resend stays «Retrimite emailul» on the registration's page.
- **«Alege tu cine primește un loc eliberat»** (new, Administrator, after «Deschide înscrierile la o cursă»): set «Ofertele din lista de așteptare pleacă automat» to «Nu» *before* raising «Număr de locuri», by as many places as are about to be handed out; «Trimite-i oferta» on a waiting row of «Coada de înscrieri» or on the registration's page; the ordinary «S-a eliberat un loc» email with the club's offer deadline and its «Confirmă locul»; a lapsed offer frees the place again; a free place is needed and the "i" says why a press would be refused; after the close the desk's «Dă-i un loc», with the person there, on paper; what the others see («Locurile se dau din lista de așteptare», newcomers queueing while anyone waits, «Lungimea maximă a listei de așteptare»); and the end of the line — once nobody is `WAITLISTED`, the places still free go to the next newcomer (§615's recipe warns of it). «Deschide înscrierile la o cursă» names the setting, and the cancellation lines (the Administrator's, the participant's) say that on «Nu» the place stays free.
- **«Ce NU se poate face»** gains: nobody gets a place without their own signature (a parent's, for a minor: until the new templates are approved the minor's own second signature stays off, §330) — an offer is accepted and signed by the person from their email, and «Dă-i un loc» confirms only on the paper declaration signed at the desk. The race-day «Nu s-a înscris deloc» says a walk-in also queues when somebody is already waiting, and that «Dă-i un loc» needs a free place.
- **The Organizer.** «Vezi cine s-a înscris» gains the places line as §615 left it: the first number counts the registrations holding a place in every state — the confirmed plus those still completing (a declaration not signed, an offer not accepted, a family's hold) — and after the dash the line names only the parts that exist, the confirmed, those in progress and the places kept for the waiting list, as in „6 înscriși din 10 locuri — 4 confirmați, 2 în curs de confirmare, 4 locuri păstrate pentru lista de așteptare” (composed from `Event.cta.fillParts`, `fillConfirmed`, `fillInProgress`, `fillKept` and `countForm`'s forms); the kept places are the free ones the waiting list claims, while the card says «Locurile se dau din lista de așteptare»; why that first number and «Cine vine» differ (the people who asked to appear); and what „1 loc oferit din lista de așteptare” on the card is (§612). «Descarcă și tipărește numerele de concurs» gains the «Nr.» column as §613 ended: before the approval the Administrator writes to those already registered with «Trimite un mesaj participanților», and a runner who does not want to appear presses «Nu vreau să apar pe lista de participanți & rezultate» in «Înscrierile mele»; from the approval the column shows every confirmed runner who has a number, whichever notice they registered under, «—» only for one without. «Ce face Administratorul, nu tu» names the bulk resend and «Trimite-i oferta».
- **The legal texts.** «Textele legale ale clubului» gains two steps that switch the «Nr.» column on, in the order of the `/admin/tasks` row `listNumbersNotice` after the owner's «forțat» (§613): first the message to those already registered — «Evenimente» → «Deschide» → «Înscrierile primite» → «Trimite un mesaj participanților» — saying their number will appear and naming the withdrawal control «Nu vreau să apar pe lista de participanți & rezultate» in «Înscrierile mele»; then the approval — the «GDPR» card → «Regenerează din șablon» → the draft → «Salvează ciorna» → «Aprobă și publică» — after which the column shows every confirmed runner who has a number, «—» only for one without, and the «Sarcini» → «Club» row until then. It sits beside the list-states line already there, in the task that walks the notice's approval.
- **The costs (§610).** «Setări» → «Costuri» → «Cât costă», and «Planul Vercel» → «Salvează planul Vercel», are one step of the Administrator's Mailgun task: the costs tab opens to the Administrator and the Vercel plan is `canManageClubSettings`, so it is not a Superadministrator's step, and the «Bugetul lunii» thresholds task stays as it was.
- **The participant (§614, §615, §616).** «Înscrierea, de la formular la codul QR» no longer says the declaration is «pe pagina care se deschide»: after the confirmation the page says it comes by email, and the email's «Semnează declarația» leads to the box «Am citit și accept declarația…» and «Semnează», which now says under the box what is missing. «Locul și termenele lui» says a place may come by itself or be chosen by the club, by the «S-a eliberat un loc» email. «O familie pe o singură adresă» says a family reserves nothing while anybody waits.
- «Primii pași» → the top bar's «Emailuri» names the hourly limit, the Gmail routes and the sending queue.

**How it is held.** `guide-words.test.ts` already holds every «…» to a label the screen shows in each language and the two guides to the same shape; a new case pins the four Administrator jobs and the new hard limit, each by its button words, in both languages, with no «Rol necesar» line. The "i" beside a refused button is an icon, not a string, so it is quoted „i” rather than «i». Gmail's «Promoții»/"Promotions" tab is Google's, not ours, and is left unquoted.

**Review round (2026-10-01).** The citations follow the landing's numbers (§607–§617). The two numbers-column steps no longer say «—» for runners registered under an older notice: the owner's «forțat» made the column every confirmed runner's, and the steps now say what the tasks row says, in its order. The Organizer's places-line step no longer quotes the earlier two-part line: the first number is the registrations holding places in every state, and a third part names the places kept for the waiting list. The guide's text carries no § number.

*Rejected:* a separate «Mailgun» section — the jobs belong to the Administrator, whose section the reader already opens; describing the Gmail takeover, the public delay notice and the replaced-link page, which other branches carry and this tree does not; quoting the places line as «…» — its catalogue value begins with a placeholder, so it is quoted „…” as an example; and shortening any task that is still true.
changelogLine: - **«Ghid» covers the October releases** — the Mailgun plan's job walks the hourly limit, the Gmail routes and «Cât costă»; three new Administrator jobs say what to do when emails are late or Mailgun refused, how to resend the declaration to everyone who has not signed, and how to choose who gets a freed place; the Organizer's jobs explain the event page's places line and the «Nr.» column, and the participant's steps say the declaration comes by email. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Criterion 38 (addition): the guide carries, in both languages, the Administrator's jobs «Emailurile întârzie sau Mailgun a refuzat», «Retrimite declarația celor care nu au semnat» and «Alege tu cine primește un loc eliberat», each naming its screen's button, and «Planul Mailgun, înainte și după cursă» names «Limita pe oră», the Gmail routes and «Cât costă»; none opens with «Rol necesar». «Ce NU se poate face» says nobody gets a place without their own signature (a parent's, for a minor): an offer is accepted and signed by the person, and the desk's «Dă-i un loc» confirms only on the paper declaration they sign. The Organizer's «Vezi cine s-a înscris» says the places line's first number counts the registrations holding a place (confirmed plus in progress) and names the places kept for the waiting list; the numbers-column steps say, as the `listNumbersNotice` row does, the message to those already registered first («Trimite un mesaj participanților»), the withdrawal control «Nu vreau să apar pe lista de participanți & rezultate», then the approval, after which every confirmed runner who has a number shows it. Verification: unit `staff/guide-words.test.ts` (2026-10-01, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: the guide covers the October releases
